name: week
title: Research facility week
subtitle: UTC times. Confirm local time before equipment use.

sections.title: Upcoming reservations
sections.sql: select code,resource,person,starts_at,ends_at,status from v_booking_week where ends_at>now() and starts_at<now()+interval '7 days' and status in ('requested','approved') order by starts_at,code

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select reference,kind,detail from v_attention order by reference,kind

sections.title: Completed sessions only
sections.sql: select code,resource,completed_sessions,booked_minutes,actual_minutes,variance_minutes from v_usage order by code
sections.note: Time totals, not a capacity utilisation percentage.
